title: Bram and the Safehouse
author: Vesper Ravensworth
blurb: Wren Ravensworth, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
